title: Aromatic Savory Saudi Arabian Lamb Noodles
description: A salty and savory Saudi Arabian dish featuring brown rice noodles, lamb, and a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This paleo-friendly recipe is made with wholesome ingredients and can be prepared in under an hour.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, cook the brown rice noodles according to package instructions.
To serve, place the cooked noodles in a bowl and top with the lamb and sauce.
